info.title: HMS Storefront Data
info.description: Agent-payable data rails for HMS storefronts: verified daily car-rental rates per class (Enterprise/Hertz, Columbus pilot) and HOS-aware, 72ft-trailer-filtered overnight truck sleep stops with Jason's Law scarcity scoring. x402 pay-per-call, USDC on Base (eip155:8453, permit2, facilitator Coinbase CDP). Honesty rule: both data routes serve free zero-record responses until >= 1 real verified record lands; the /v1/coverage endpoint exposes live coverage so agents never pay for empty data.
info.x-guidance: Pay-per-call x402 v2 (scheme exact, USDC on Base permit2). While a dataset has zero real records (check the free /v1/coverage endpoint first), its route serves a free 200 zero-records response and charges nothing. Once coverage >= 1 real record, an unpaid GET on the route returns HTTP 402 with a base64 JSON challenge in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402Version 2, accepts[].amount in USDC atomic units, top-level extensions.bazaar discovery); pay and replay with the x-payment header to receive 200 JSON plus a PAYMENT-RESPONSE settle receipt. Free: /health, /v1/coverage, and this /openapi.json. Rate limit 20 requests/min/IP.
